verdict.rationale: Teller is API-first: balances, transactions, identity, account details, and payments are all documented API resources, and pagination and idempotency are supported (teller-docs-2/3/4/5/20/21). However, webhook registration is documented as a Teller Dashboard action (teller-docs-7), and account linking runs through the Teller Connect UI component (teller-docs-23, teller-gh-1), so evidence shows some operations are UI-only rather than at full parity. Missing for 10: documented API parity for dashboard/admin operations such as webhook configuration, a programmatic enrollment path without Connect, and a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404, teller-probe-3).
